curated-gf-rakkas-gf-wix-madefor-text: Tight, coiled and loud, Rakkas packs its letters shoulder to shoulder. Wix Madefor Text lets its terminals hang open beneath that crush, a contemporary sans that does best with quick bits of text rather than pages.
curated-gf-raleway-dots-gf-besley: Commanding from the first glyph, Raleway Dots pairs heavy stems with hairline strokes (a retro bowling league shirt, say). And Besley, its crossbars a touch thinner than its stems, keeps a few lines moving with dignified editorial ease.
curated-gf-ramaraja-fs-fira-sans: Authoritative and tightly spaced, Ramaraja sets heavy trunks against whisper-thin branches in every letter. Fira Sans stands taller in the lowercase with stout diagonals, so its size can shrink a notch without losing clarity.
curated-gf-rampart-one-gf-david-libre: Shuttered yet stretched, Rampart One draws horizontals slimmer than its verticals, with the spacing pulled loose as an uncoiled spring. David Libre reads refined and unhurried across a few lines, terminals hanging open.
curated-gf-ramsina-gf-atkinson-hyperlegi: Spacing as narrow as the gap between sheets of glass defines Ramsina, a dignified, bookish serif with terminals crowding each curve. Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono lets generous open counters breathe against that tight crowding.
curated-gf-ramsina-gf-noto-sans-syriac-w: Noto Sans Syriac Western holds its terminals far out from the stroke. Ramsina, the dignified, bookish serif heading, crowds its curves tight, which sets off that modern openness below.
curated-gf-ranchers-gf-gentium-plus: Gentium Plus gives every c the wide mouth of a pitcher. Ranchers, commanding and crammed like beads on a wire, narrows every opening, which leaves the pair better with brief text than long paragraphs.
curated-gf-rancho-gf-della-respira: Handwritten casualness leads here, with Rancho's tightly packed, graceful letters. Della Respira brings a serif's editorial authority, capitals towering over the lowercase, a firm footing for friendly handwriting in quick reads.
curated-gf-rancho-gf-m-plus-1: Rancho writes tightly packed, friendly letters by hand, and M PLUS 1 draws tubular strokes with generous eyes. The body text feels pleasant in quick sips rather than long sittings.
curated-gf-rancho-gf-sometype-mono: Sometype Mono sets fixed-width, code-style letters with open-mouthed curves. Rancho's graceful handwriting loosens the look, while longer text stays structured and technical, happiest in short bursts (a rave flyer, maybe).
